The empty-repo (no journal) and malformed-registry assertions are unchanged and still pass.

Mission status changes caused by a run are embedded in the run journal entry (payload.mission {missionId, from, to, reason}) instead of a separate MISSION_TRANSITIONED entry, so the run step and the mission move are one atomic append; both write and replay check them with core/mission/state-machine.ts.

Mission path used: AUTHORIZED -> PLANNED at run creation, PLANNED -> EXECUTING at IMPLEMENT, -> VERIFYING after IMPLEMENT, -> REVIEWING after VERIFY, -> REGRESSION after a CLEAN review, -> REPORTING after the regression test run. The REGRESSION step re-runs the test command in a fresh clone of the reviewed commit.

Without an executor configuration POST /v1/missions/:id/runs returns 409 EXECUTOR_NOT_CONFIGURED. The FAKE adapter can only be injected programmatically (buildServer executors option / MissionRunner); no env value selects it. UASCO_WORKOS_EXECUTOR=local-claude selects LOCAL_CLAUDE; any other value is refused.

LOCAL_CLAUDE implement reuses scripts/claude-builder-broker.mjs unchanged. LOCAL_CLAUDE review re-checks provider provenance like the broker (final PASS, launcher sha256) and runs the captured launcher with Read,Grep,Glob only, because the broker applies the builder tool policy. Neither path is executed in this package.

Read-only review is enforced by detection: after review the clean clone must still be at the reviewed commit with an empty 'git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all', otherwise the run is BLOCKED (REVIEWER_MUTATED_CLONE).

testCommand is an optional argv field on project and mission (mission overrides project). Only 'node' is resolved to process.execPath; other allow-listed executables are spawned by name with shell:false, so Windows .cmd shims (npm, npx, pnpm, yarn) are not spawnable and give BLOCKED TEST_COMMAND_SPAWN_FAILED. A missing test command gives BLOCKED TEST_COMMAND_NOT_CONFIGURED.
The engine reads the run queue across tenants through engine-only methods (engineListRuns/engineGetRun); API routes use tenant-scoped reads only.
Lease heartbeats are RUN_LEASE RENEW journal entries (every leaseTtlMs/3, default TTL 120 s) and are also written between steps.

GLOBAL_STOP is checked before each step, between steps, and polled every 250 ms during child processes; an active stop kills the child process tree (taskkill /T on Windows) and the run goes CANCELLING -> CANCELLED with the mission BLOCKED.
Secret scan covers private keys, AWS, GitHub, Anthropic and OpenAI-like tokens on added diff lines only; hits record kind/file/line, never the value, and logs are redacted with the same patterns.

remediation.//TR: Bu bölüm F-B3A-001 (sınırsız crash/lease recovery döngüsü) düzeltmesini ve gözlenen komut sonuçlarını kaydeder; temiz değildir, inceleme beklemektedir.
changes: core/workos/runner.ts: new option maxRecoveries (default 2). recoverCheck computes recoveries since the last checkpoint as run.attempt minus the attempt stored in the last checkpoint's data (1 when no checkpoint exists). Every TAKEOVER increments attempt in the journal, so the count advances even if no RECOVERY evidence could be written. When recoveries > maxRecoveries the step is NOT re-run: RECOVERY evidence (exitCode 1, problems RECOVERY_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED) is written and the run moves to RECOVERY_FAILED with the mission BLOCKED, both with reason RECOVERY_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED.
core/workos/runner.ts: checkpoint data (DONE and REMEDIATE) now records attempt, the baseline for the budget.

core/workos/runner.ts: lease renewal added at the start of every step in drive() (so also between steps) and right after the long synchronous git work: after clone/checkout in WORKSPACE, after the reset before the implementer call in IMPLEMENT, after git diff in VERIFY, after the fresh clone + diff before the reviewer call in REVIEW, after the fresh clone in REGRESSION. If the lease already expired the renewal throws WORKOS_LEASE_FENCED and the step stops before any further side effect or paid executor call.

Repeated crash during IMPLEMENT with maxRecoveries 0 and 2: implementer called exactly 1 + maxRecoveries times, reviewer 0 times, run RECOVERY_FAILED, mission BLOCKED.
Budget is per checkpoint position: 2 recoveries at IMPLEMENT plus 2 at VERIFY still reach AWAITING_APPROVAL (attempt 5, checkpoint attempts [1,3,5,5,5,5]).
Lease renewal: each evidence write advances the clock 25 s (175 s total, TTL 60 s); the run completes in one tick with attempt 1, no takeover, no fencing, at least 6 RENEW entries.

deviations: The budget baseline is stored in checkpoint data (data.attempt) instead of a new store field, so no journal schema or replay change was needed. Checkpoints written by a125001 without data.attempt fall back to baseline 1 (stricter, fail-closed).

The budget is counted per checkpoint position (recoveries since the last completed checkpoint), so a run that makes progress between crashes is not stopped; each single step is re-run at most maxRecoveries times.
Clone and diff remain synchronous; explicit renewals after them were chosen over making them asynchronous (minimal change).
